overview.tier: A / B+ (Lolalytics B+, rank 41/112; high ban rate)
overview.rankFilter: Emerald+ (OP.GG, patch 26.19). Lolalytics Emerald+ shows 53.13% WR / 7.07% PR / 16.22% BR.
overview.playstyle: You are a tank engage champion who wins with resistances and Unstoppable Force. Farm safely with Seismic Shard poke and Granite Shield, build Sunfire Aegis, Thornmail and Frozen Heart, and hit multi-target ultimates in teamfights. Against auto-attackers your armor scaling and Ground Slam attack speed cripple make you very hard to kill. You are weak against ranged poke and kiting champions in the first levels, and against champions who ignore armor with true or percent damage.

seasonNotes: 26.02: Ground Slam base damage cut to 60/95/130/165/200 (mana costs raised) and Unstoppable Force cooldown raised to 130/115/100 s. Thunderclap monster damage 180%.
25.20 to 25.23: base armor raised to 40; Ground Slam had been buffed to 80/120/160/200/240 (since reduced in 26.02).
26.19 (current): no Malphite changes on Summoner's Rift; his notes are League Classic mode fixes only. Tank item change: World Atlas and Runic Compass (support items) only.
26.19: Role quest Teleport cooldown 420 s -> 390 s; Unleashed Teleport 330-240 s -> 300-210 s. Your top quest Teleport is more available for side-lane and fight plays.
Thunderclap bonus damage is 30-70 +20% AP +15% armor with a 6 s window (wiki, 26.09).
Malphite is a top pick and ban right now: about 7% pick and 16% ban in Emerald+ with a 51-53% win rate.
Role quest: your top quest gives a free Unleashed Teleport. With Teleport equipped it gives a shield and a lower cooldown instead, so Flash + Teleport stays the default.

abilities.name: Granite Shield
abilities.summary: Shield worth 10% of max health that comes back after 8/7/6 s (by level) without taking damage. You also grow in size with armor.
tips: Poke with Q, then step out of range so the shield recharges before the next trade.
Keep the shield up when you fight: Thunderclap triples its armor bonus while the shield is active.
Do not trade into minions and turret for free damage; you lose the shield and the W armor bonus.

abilities.name: Seismic Shard
abilities.summary: Range 625 magic damage (70-270 +60% AP) that slows the target 20-40% for 3 s. You gain movement speed equal to the slow.
tips: Poke on the wave whenever it is up; the movement speed lets you walk away after.
Use it on a melee champion who tries to run you down or on anyone who runs from you.
Save it to slow a target before Unstoppable Force so you land the R.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.summary: Passive armor bonus (10-30%, tripled while Granite Shield is up). Active: within 6 s your next attack has +50 range and deals bonus damage (30-70 +20% AP +15% armor) in a small area.
tips: Use W in the middle of a wave to clear it fast and shove.
Trade with W > AA > Q > E while your shield is up, so the armor bonus is tripled.
Take W second or third; the armor passive matters more than the damage in lane.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.summary: Area magic damage (60-200 +60% AP +40% armor) around you that cripples attack speed 30-50% for 3 s.
tips: Use it on an auto-attacker before they hit you in a fight; it works best against marksmen and duelists.
Damage scales with armor: it gets stronger with each armor item.
Costs 50-70 mana; do not spam it on an empty wave with Doran's Ring.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.summary: Range 1000 dash that cannot be interrupted by displacement, dealing 200/300/400 (+90% AP) magic damage and knocking up all enemies hit for 1.5 s. Cooldown 130/115/100 s.
tips: Aim for 3 or more enemies in a fight, or lock down the carry the team wants dead.
Slow with Q first, then R, so a moving target cannot walk out of it.
In lane, use it with your jungler for a kill at level 6, not as a solo engage.

combos.name: Poke trade
combos.when: The enemy steps up to last hit; your shield is up and you can leave before they answer.

combos.name: Standard trade
combos.when: Level 3 and up, shield up, enemy is melee or an auto-attacker.

combos.name: Engage with R
combos.when: Level 6 with your jungler close, or in a teamfight to knock up several enemies and cripple them.

combos.name: Flash R
combos.when: Catching a fleeing carry or hitting a backline that stands out of range.

runes.name: Arcane Comet (most played)
runes.when: Default (54.35% pick, 51.51% WR on OP.GG). Comet pokes with Q and lets you farm and trade safely.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying (melee lanes)
runes.when: Against melee champions that fight you constantly, or if you want lane sustain (22.96% pick, 51.81% WR on OP.GG). OP.GG page: Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth + Transcendence, Gathering Storm. Lolalytics prefers Conditioning over Second Wind (53.52% WR).

runes.name: Arcane Comet + Inspiration
runes.when: Comet poke with boots speed (14.74% pick, 50.51% WR on OP.GG). Slightly weaker than the standard page.

summoners.when: Default (74.08% pick, 50.89% WR on OP.GG). Lets you return to lane after a recall and join fights.
Highest win rate (23.79% pick, 52.90% WR on OP.GG; 54.66% on Lolalytics). Take it in lanes where you can kill with your jungler or you win trades.
Against melee champions you cannot escape from otherwise, like Darius. Rare; no verified win rate.

skillOrder.notes: OP.GG: Q > E > W max order, R at 6/11/16 (48.55% pick, 55.12% WR). Lolalytics: Q at 1, E at 2, W at 4, max Q > E > W (same max order). Take W earlier if you need faster wave clear and armor.

startingItems.when: Default (72.06% pick, 51.40% WR on OP.GG). Mana for Q and E and safe farming.
Against ranged poke or melee bullies like Darius (14.69% pick, 51.40% WR on OP.GG).
Lolalytics top starter (53.43% WR); tankier start when you expect long trades.

firstItemOptions.when: Default first item (48.22% of builds on OP.GG, 53.18% WR). Wave clear and constant damage in fights.
Against strong auto-attackers and marksmen when you need to slow their attack speed (36.08% of builds, 55.71% WR as an item).
AP hybrid path (30.95% of builds, 51.37% WR): Malignance, Stormsurge, Shadowflame. Play it only when your team needs damage and you are ahead.

boots.when: Default (64.19% pick, 52.93% WR on OP.GG). Against AD-heavy teams and auto-attackers.
Against heavy AP damage or lots of crowd control (23.54% pick on OP.GG).

firstBackBuys.buy: Bami's Cinder - first step to Sunfire Aegis; buy Boots instead if you are being hit hard by AD.
Bami's Cinder plus Cloth Armor or Chain Vest - if you are being hit by AD and need armor now.
Sunfire Aegis components: Bami's Cinder, Chain Vest, Cloth Armor - finish Sunfire Aegis on your second back.

items.name: Sunfire Aegis
items.why: Standard first item: health, resistances and constant area damage.

items.name: Thornmail
items.why: Armor and Grievous Wounds against auto-attackers who hit you (44.04% of builds, 53.79% WR).

items.name: Frozen Heart
items.why: Armor and a big attack speed slow around you; also increases Ground Slam damage.

items.name: Jak'Sho, The Protean
items.why: Resistances that grow in long fights; standard fourth item (58.56% WR as 4th item).

items.name: Randuin's Omen
items.why: Reduces crit damage and slows attackers (58.72% WR as 4th item).

items.name: Kaenic Rookern
items.why: Health, magic resist and a magic damage shield (Sunfire + Thornmail + Kaenic: 53.80% WR).

items.name: Force of Nature
items.why: Magic resist for sustained magic damage.

items.name: Abyssal Mask
items.why: Magic resist that makes nearby enemies take more magic damage.

items.name: Spirit Visage
items.why: Magic resist and health with better healing and shielding; helps against magic poke.

items.name: Dead Man's Plate
items.why: Armor, health and speed to reach the fight and to run down squishies.

items.name: Warmog's Armor
items.why: Huge health and regeneration when you are the main tank.

items.name: Gargoyle Stoneplate
items.why: Resistances and a big shield in a fight when you are focused.

items.name: Unending Despair
items.why: Armor and health with damage around you in fights; strong late slot on Lolalytics.

items.name: Liandry's Torment
items.why: Burn damage on high-health targets; use when you want to deal damage as well.

items.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
items.why: Armor, AP and Stasis after you land your R.

items.name: Malignance
items.why: AP hybrid first item: ability haste makes Unstoppable Force come back faster.

items.name: Stormsurge
items.why: AP hybrid burst item; second item of the one-shot build.

items.name: Shadowflame
items.why: Magic penetration for the AP hybrid build; finishes low-health squishies after your R.

items.name: Plated Steelcaps
items.why: Default boots against auto-attackers (52.93% WR).

items.name: Mercury's Treads
items.why: Magic resist and tenacity against crowd control.

powerSpikes.what: Weak. Farm safely and use Q to poke only when it is safe.
Q, E and W together give you your first strong trade while your shield is up.
Unstoppable Force gives you kill pressure with your jungler and safe wave pushes.
First big spike: you clear waves quickly and do constant damage in fights.
Very hard to kill; Ground Slam scales with your armor and your R is your main threat in teamfights.
Rank 2 and 3 of Unstoppable Force: more damage and a shorter cooldown for each teamfight.
